title: Glitches are thought to be caused by superfluid vortex motion.
purpose: Explain the leading theory for glitches.
narration: Pulsar glitches are sudden increases in rotation speed. The leading theory suggests they are caused by the motion of superfluid vortices inside the neutron star. When these vortices become unpinned, they transfer angular momentum outward, speeding up the star's crust. This model is widely accepted but still being refined.
